entries.description: Give a text product or model, quantity and must-have specs. A successful China Supply Check returns three evidence-backed China B2B platform-shop supplier candidates worth advancing to RFQ, separating product fit from supplier capability. Free brief preparation is available; the bounded paid check costs 2.99 USDC on Base. Listing prices are not current quotes and shops are not verified manufacturers.

nextAction.scope: one confirmed RFQ, up to three selected suppliers, one authorized human outreach round, 72-hour response window; no guaranteed replies
